claims.author: musaHaruna
claims.quote: Should the early availability check also cover non-pruned nodes? They can load a snapshot without having the historical block or undo data.
claims.request: Extend the early block/undo data availability check to non-pruned nodes to avoid copying the UTXO set before failing rollback

claims.request: Compare the missing-data boundary against target height using > instead of >= to avoid rejecting valid rollbacks to the target height
